basis: Visual reconstruction of the public opening; central white door is a requested change.

world.surface: Black water-like reflection, transverse geometric microripples

preview_views.Opening_WhiteDoor.png: 18 m from door, 20 mm, player eye height 1.65 m
preview_views.Opening_WhiteDoor_Near.png: 6 m from door, 20 mm, player eye height 1.65 m
preview_views.WhiteDoor_Detail.png: Angled detail, camera offset (2.1, -4.4, 1.7) from door base

godot_suggestions.renderer: Forward+ for glow; standard GLB PBR emission also works without glow.
godot_suggestions.environment: Set background black; ambient light disabled; tune glow bloom subtly, retain six-panel detail.
godot_suggestions.exposure: Start at 1.0, use filmic tone mapping; adjust point light energy to maintain a local floor glow.
godot_suggestions.collisions: Import -colonly suffix as collision only; do not create collision from visual door leaf.
godot_suggestions.transition: Create Area3D near DoorArrival; central door opening has no solid collider.
godot_suggestions.fog: No fog required; if desired use near-black very low density, avoid a visible white room.
godot_suggestions.reflections: Enable screen-space reflections or add a ReflectionProbe; emission alone cannot light or reflect in every real-time renderer. Keep background black.
godot_suggestions.asset_library: Add asset_library as a Blender Asset Library; drag WhiteDoor_Reusable collection.

verification.visual_review: Passed via view_image: 18 m start, 6 m near view and angled detail. White door farther away; black background and rippled reflection retained.
